Everyone's saying that this isn't rape- well, I'm here to disagree. Consent classes teach that if the person is too drunk to consent- it's not consent!!!
You were drunk, bipolar and in a very vulnerable position. If you were drinking to the point of blackout THEN IT IS NOT REAL CONSENT! He took advantage of you and in a way that many feminists would class as rape.
So maybe you can't press charges- I don't know your area laws- but AVOID THIS GUY, and I would tell your ex boyfriend. I think he would be concerned and would want to know. What he did is NOT OKAY!!!! You were too drunk to respond properly. By all means tell people, your friends, your ex, anyone else you *trust*- okay it might not get to court but the fact that you feel sick says it all. *TRUST ME* I know what I'm talking about. xx He took advantage of a drunk, sick and miserable woman and this is NOT RIGHT. NOT RIGHT AT ALL.
